name: Matignon's Cipher-3 (as used in BnF fr. 15572 ff. 277-280 and fr. 15573 ff. 379-381)
sign_names: visual names of reference sheet v2 (stageA/sheet-v2.json) plus q, v, oo, Lp, Lx2; stage E adds Bn, eps, z3 (split from B, xi, 9t on the image) 60, Sq and 4; stage F adds zz (split from xi on the image), Noo and 13; Gc (a 9 in a circle) and 6 (a plain figure 6), told apart from S on the image

origins.E: EM alignment of our reading of fr. 15572 ff. 277r and 278r with their contemporary decipherment ff. 279r and 280r (stageA/key-v2.json counts); stage E adds f. 277v aligned by eye with f. 279v; stage F adds fr. 15570 ff. 271r-272r (Sept. 1585) aligned with its decipherment f. 273r-v
origins.E?: EM, few occurrences (< 6) or split: doubtful
origins.C?: conjecture from context in the target itself (a code value); doubtful, listed for checking

note: Values are plaintext units; a list means the sign stands for any of them (homophones are separate signs; a list is a polyphone or a code with variants); "" = null. Nothing here was taken from anyone's modern reading of these letters.

Z.origin: T+E (i); y E? (5 of 69 on ff. 277r/278r)

d.origin: T (f) + E (vostre: 8 aligned occurrences on fr. 15570 ff. 271-272 vs f. 273)

longs.origin: T (b = long s; the sheet's longs is a long s joined to +, l) + E (b 3, br 1)

#.origin: i: E (3 of 5 on f. 277r; target pres#dent, ma#este); r: T (Tomokiyo's r column, row 6) + E (rr once)

tri.origin: E? (t 1 of 1 on f. 277r; f. 277v l. 32 'batterie')

excl.origin: E? (f. 277v l. 16 'les suisses qui sont'; a variant of dots)

Bn.origin: T (Tomokiyo n column, row 6); class split from B on the image

eps.origin: T (Tomokiyo c column, row 2); class split from xi on the image

z3.origin: T (Tomokiyo m column, row 6); class split from 9t on the image

Sq.origin: T (Tomokiyo's q column: an S/5 on a swash, drawn grey there); class split on the image from S, g, Lq, Lr

4.origin: T (Tomokiyo's s column: a plain 4); class split from 14 on the image

zz.origin: E (fr. 15570 ff. 271r-272r vs f. 273: rassemble, sasseure, assembler, asseure, ieusse; f. 278r promesse); class split from xi on the image

Noo.origin: E? (code group; one aligned occurrence, fr. 15570 f. 271v l. 9 vs f. 273r 'empescher le roy de Navarre conduire')

13.origin: E? (one aligned occurrence, fr. 15570 f. 271v l. 9 vs f. 273r 'quil a faict sortir'; doubtful)

Gc.origin: E (fr. 15570 f. 272r 'revanche par la prinse', 'par l'intelligence' vs f. 273v; known-answer page f. 278r 'mande par le sieur' vs f. 280r)

6.origin: E? (one aligned occurrence: fr. 15570 f. 271r 'venus trouver' vs f. 273r)

revision_note: 18-19 Oct 2026 (stage F): Gc = par (E), 6 = s (E?), from fr. 15570 ff. 271r-272r and its 1585 decipherment f. 273; Gc also on the known-answer page.
